name: TSR Living Solution Public Company Limited
summary: TSR Living Solution Public Company Limited, known as Thiensurat Public Company Limited, focuses on the manufacturing and distribution of water purification systems across Thailand. The company's diverse operations also encompass the supply of a wide array of household appliances, including televisions, refrigerators, water heaters, washing machines, air purifiers, and freezers. Beyond consumer goods, TSR provides financial services, extending personal and automotive loans to its clientele. Additionally, its business activities involve the sale, leasing, and maintenance of ice maker machines. This enterprise, headquartered in Nonthaburi, Thailand, was founded in 1976.
